notes.title: Title: New version 0.9965 of Liberation Special Forces Weapons And Tactics avail
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047760/916a42c2e8376a691bd455c682a7e18fbdef5708.png[/img]

Welcome to our new version if any one wants to try out cheats check these ones only avaiable from this new.

Basic Cheat List: 

Overview: Press control c and you will deploy the cheat console. 

RevealEnemy : shows all enemies on GPS
Inmortal: you become inmortal
Spectator: you become spectator
SuccesuflMission: you win 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047760/be96c8171afe7217340db950e88616392c15a4c6.png[/img]

And the bug fixes are: 

-Stances and leaning improved. 
-new map Rotation at the end of game it will take a random map and gamemode Campaign or Quick Game. 
-A lot more bugs and other features we won't mention.

notes.title: LSF 1 Liberation Special Forces version 0.996 Weapons and tactics in store!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047760/65658c36eb4d2500fa4d28484d7a7300c6f29c3a.png[/img]
It is been a long time with no updates but this one is pretty good, solid and full of stuff, remember those typical 5 or 10 weapons now there are a lot more with special characteistics and the way to lead your team is better. 

- You now have the SFPAD that aka tablet of combat or combat tablet, you can easilt lead your team through that. 
- You have an infinite amount of groups to lead them and fight hard with the brain. 
- You have drones and turrets as robots to elimanate locate the enemy easily.

notes.title: Liberation Special Forces Version 0.95
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to liberation special forces, in which you are a special forces group trying to liberate citzens across the world, with advanced weapons and other gear, the game is early acces, and so we are adding a lot of new features and we are still developing it. 
But here is what there is that is solid. 
-2 Campaigns of 20 minutes on every difficulty you imagine....
-Squad to give orders formations V and so. 

Fixes 

-Menu sound control fixed. 
-Menu a little bit changed. 
-Some weapons are fixed

New stuff

-New pvp capture the flag gamemode. 

What there is yet to come: 

The territory liberation gamemode
Civilians
Vehicles 
......
